verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's official docs claim the FP8 Transformer Engine accelerates 'LLM prototyping, inference, and AI development across frameworks like TensorFlow and PyTorch' and point to the general CUDA Toolkit as the supported software stack, but a hands-on community report explicitly notes the RTX PRO 6000's SM120 architecture 'lacks support in main libraries' since ecosystem focus has gone to B300/SM100, a concrete technical gap rather than vague skepticism. Missing for 10: an official PyTorch/framework support matrix or install guide specific to this card, and evidence resolving the SM120 library-support gap raised by users.
